pois.name: Waterbom Bali
pois.description: Asia's #1 water park for multiple years. 37 slides and attractions across 3.8 ha of tropical gardens, including the 360° vertical-loop Superbowl and the Climax free-fall.

pois.name: Hard Rock Hotel Bali
pois.description: Kuta's landmark beachfront hotel with the largest rock-music memorabilia collection in Asia, a world-class spa, and a beachside pool complex.

pois.name: Kuta Beach
pois.description: Bali's most famous beach: 4km of grey volcanic sand, reliable beginner surf, sunset vendors, and Bali's iconic lifeguard towers with their red-and-yellow flags.

pois.name: Beachwalk Shopping Center
pois.description: Open-air lifestyle mall steps from Kuta Beach with international brands, cinemas, food court, and a rooftop pool. The main air-conditioned refuge on Kuta's strip.

pois.name: Sky Garden Bali
pois.description: Six floors of clubs, bars, and rooftop terrace on Legian Street. The beating heart of Kuta's nightlife with a legendary free-entry-before-11pm policy.

pois.name: Legian Beach
pois.description: Quieter, wider beach north of Kuta with fewer vendors, slightly more powerful surf, and most of Kuta's upscale beachfront hotels.

pois.name: Discovery Shopping Mall
pois.description: Kuta's original mall directly on the beach. Three floors of surf brands, souvenirs, restaurants, and a beachfront Hard Rock Cafe.

pois.name: Poppies Restaurant
pois.description: Kuta's most famous restaurant, opened 1973. Garden courtyard setting, long Indonesian and Western menu, and the original Poppies cocktail.

pois.name: Fat Yogi's
pois.description: Kuta institution since 1981. Enormous portions of Indonesian staples — nasi goreng, mie goreng, satay — at backpacker prices in an open-air setting.

pois.name: Mango's Bali
pois.description: Three-floor nightclub and restaurant on Legian Street. Well-known for its 2-for-1 cocktail happy hour and live music on the upper terrace.

pois.name: Bagus Café
pois.description: Classic Kuta breakfast spot with thick pancakes, fresh fruit, and Indonesian coffee that's been fuelling surfers since the 1980s.

pois.name: Krisna Bali
pois.description: Three floors of Balinese handicrafts, branded souvenirs, textiles, and food products. The most popular one-stop souvenir emporium in Bali.

pois.name: Pro Surf School Kuta
pois.description: Long-running surf school operating directly from Kuta Beach. Group lessons at 08:00 and 14:00 on Kuta's gentle beach-break.

pois.name: Apache Reggae Bar
pois.description: Kuta's most authentic live-music bar. Nightly reggae bands, no cover charge, cold Bintang, and a crowd that mixes locals with travellers.

pois.name: Kuta Art Market
pois.description: Open-air market along Poppies Lane II with batik sarongs, silver jewellery, woodcarvings, and essential oil vendors. Bargaining expected.

pois.name: Pantai Kuta Fitness
pois.description: Beachfront gym with ocean view cardio machines, free weights, and yoga studio. Day passes available for travelers.

pois.name: Bounty Nightclub
pois.description: Built around a replica 18th-century ship on Legian Street. Three dance floors, foam parties on Fridays, and a capacity of 2,000.

pois.name: Kuta Sunset Point
pois.description: The southernmost point of Kuta Beach, where surfers and photographers gather every evening for Bali's most accessible Indian Ocean sunsets.
